Curated Editorial Overview: Detailed analysis of the most profound, game-changing shifts across Open Food Facts over the rolling year (November 2025 – November 2026), from automated environmental lifecycle scoring with Ecobalyse to privacy-first receipt anonymization, the launch of OpenFoodFacts Explorer, and multi-language SDK upgrades.
Game-Changing Ecological Assessment 2026-10-30
openfoodfacts-server

Ecobalyse Automated Life-Cycle Environmental Impact Engine

Open Food Facts now directly connects with the French government's Ecobalyse API to compute granular product life-cycle environmental scores on every update. By matching taxonomy categories, ingredient ratios, and packaging specs with Ecobalyse lifecycle data, Open Food Facts brings unprecedented scientific precision to environmental transparency.

Highlights

  • Automated real-time Ecobalyse API calculation triggered upon product edits, with smart stale caching to guarantee fault tolerance.
  • Life-cycle distribution, consumption, and processing factors mapped from taxonomy categories.
  • Deep packaging mapping and Forest Footprint SVG integration for deforestation risk tracking.
Server v2.118.0 Release ↗Ecobalyse Mapping PR #14646 ↗
Game-Changing Food Inflation & Crowdsourcing 2026-08-01
open-pricesopen-prices-frontend

Open Prices Receipt Anonymizer & Geospatial Search Ecosystem

Open Prices reached major maturity milestones with a privacy-preserving Receipt Anonymizer, nearby geospatial querying, concurrent ML receipt recognition, and the addition of non-food categories from Open Products Facts. Millions of crowdsourced prices are now shared while protecting contributor identity.

Highlights

  • Built-in Receipt Anonymizer tool allowing shoppers to blur or strip personal payment details, store loyalty numbers, and transaction IDs before proof submission.
  • Geospatial radius filter (`lat`, `lon`, `radius_km`) allowing consumers and apps to compare grocery prices in their local vicinity.
  • New products.jsonl.gz open data dump dedicated exclusively to products with recorded prices.
  • Expansion to Open Products Facts categories (fuels, tickets, non-food goods) and community reuse integrations.
Open Prices v1.116.0 Release ↗Receipt Anonymizer PR #2255 ↗Open Prices Platform ↗
Game-Changing Next-Gen Web UI 2026-11-04
openfoodfacts-explorer

Launch of OpenFoodFacts Explorer & OFF Days 2026 Overhaul

Born in early 2026 and propelled to v0.2.0 for OFF Days 2026, OpenFoodFacts Explorer represents the new modern web interface for Open Food Facts: instant multi-lingual search autocomplete, interactive faceted discovery, client-side camera barcode scanning, and rich product cards.

Highlights

  • Ultra-fast faceted browsing across categories, brands, labels (Bio, Fair Trade), Nutri-Score, and Eco-Score.
  • Browser-native BarcodeDetector integration with html5-qrcode fallback for seamless in-browser scanning on mobile and desktop.
  • Direct inline editing workflow enabling contributors to improve product attributes without leaving the modern view.
Explorer v0.2.0 Release ↗OpenFoodFacts Explorer Repository ↗
Game-Changing Mobile Architecture 2026-08-24
smooth-appopenfoodfacts-dart

Smooth App: Offline Background Sync & Folksonomy Properties

Smooth App (v4.23 – v4.24) transformed mobile contribution resilience with background task workers for folksonomy engine updates, robust stale background task recovery, allergen & trace customization, and pet food nutrition tracking in the underlying Dart SDK.

Highlights

  • Asynchronous background task runner for Folksonomy tags, enabling contributors to tag custom properties (e.g., packaging materials, certifications) without waiting on network calls.
  • Stale background task management ensuring edits survive intermittent connectivity and app restarts.
  • Advanced ingredient filtering ('unwanted ingredients' and 'ingredient filter') powered by openfoodfacts-dart v3.30.0.
Smooth App v4.24.0 Release ↗Smooth App v4.23.0 Release ↗
Game-Changing AI & Data Quality 2026-10-20
robotoffopenfoodfacts-serveropenfoodfacts-webcomponents

Robotoff AI OCR & NutriPatrol Automated Quality Patrol

Major leaps in automated data quality: Robotoff expanded image-based questions and insight predictions, while Open Food Facts Server integrated spelling correction algorithms for OCR ingredient lists and NutriPatrol automated warning systems.

Highlights

  • New `with_image` parameter and image classifier refinements in Robotoff and Python SDK.
  • OCR spell-checking and ingredient parsing corrections for Scandinavian, German, and multilingual labels.
  • NutriPatrol web component allowing contributors to flag data quality inconsistencies directly on product views.
Robotoff v1.85.14 Release ↗Webcomponents v1.17.0 NutriPatrol ↗
Game-Changing Developer Ecosystem 2026-11-09
openfoodfacts-swiftopenfoodfacts-pythonopenfoodfacts-webcomponentsopenfoodfacts-dartopenfoodfacts-js

SDK Modernization: Swift SDK 1.0, Python SDK 5.x & Modern Web Components

The developer ecosystem gained a massive boost: Open Food Facts Swift SDK celebrated its official 1.0.0 release for iOS and macOS, Python SDK rolled out version 5.x with modernized classifiers and async APIs, and Web Components introduced standalone image cropping.

Highlights

  • Swift SDK 1.0.0: Native Swift concurrency, modern async/await networking, and strongly typed product representations for Apple platforms.
  • Python SDK 5.x: Updated image classifiers, support for Python 3.13+, full taxonomy download caching, and modernized OpenAPI client.
  • Open Food Facts Web Components v1.19.0: Standalone interactive image cropper component for crowdsourced packaging uploads.

🚀 v0.2.0 - OFF Days 2026 Core openfoodfacts-explorer 4 Nov 2026

🚀 v0.2.0 - OFF Days 2026

This release brings new ways to discover products, improvements to product pages and editing, and a more reliable barcode scanner. ✨ Highlights

Read release details

This release brings new ways to discover products, improvements to product pages and editing, and a more reliable barcode scanner.

✨ Highlights

🔍 Search & Discovery

  • Export search results to CSV and see summarized result counts
  • Filter facets in advanced search and browse parent and child facet values
  • Explore products through a new navigation menu
  • Improved product comparison controls and collapsible nutrition values on mobile

🧾 Product Pages

  • Redesigned product identity card and a new product-page sidebar
  • Product history in the Contribution card
  • Reverse image search with Google Lens and Yandex
  • Faster product image loading and clearer barcode information

✏️ Editing & Contribution

  • Revamped product addition form and a sidebar for product editing
  • Add allergens, traces, generic names, prices, and structured packaging
  • Replace existing images and manage product languages
  • Moderator tools for barcode correction, image management, and product status

📷 Barcode Scanning

  • GS1 barcode support and a ZXing fallback
  • Retry handling and manual barcode entry after a scan timeout

👤 Preferences & Navigation

  • Personalized classification preference and automatic moderator mode
  • Improved language and locale support
  • Static pages displayed directly in Explorer

Typed Documents and sorted raw data SDKs openfoodfacts-php 25 Feb 2020

Typed Documents and sorted raw data

This release adds typed Documents for each API OpenFoodFacts\Document\FoodDocument;

Read release details

This release adds typed Documents for each API

  • OpenFoodFacts\Document\FoodDocument;
  • OpenFoodFacts\Document\PetDocument;
  • OpenFoodFacts\Document\BeautyDocument;
  • OpenFoodFacts\Document\ProductDocument;
    These all extend from the fromer used OpenFoodFacts\Document - so no breaking interfaces.

The Document Class now also has a function "getData()" which returns the array representation of the Document.
As the OFF-API returns a randomly ordered JSON on each call, the function also recursively sorts the data by key and string.

Updated README for better usage.
